storylines.name: Place and pay for an order
storylines.quote:
A Customer places an order from the storefront (items, quantities, prices, total). Placing an order records who ordered, what, and when.
2. Once an order is placed, a payment is requested for its total. This happens automatically; nobody clicks anything.
3. The payment provider calls us back when a payment is captured. We record the capture (amount, provider reference, time). This is not initiated by anyone in the company.

storylines.name: Staff work the open orders
storylines.quote: Fulfillment Staff see a dashboard of open orders: placed orders, with the capture time once paid.

storylines.name: Customer follows their order
storylines.quote: A Customer sees their order's status on their account page: placed, payment requested, paid.

storylines.name: Customer cancels an order
storylines.quote: A Customer can cancel an order from their account page. Cancelled orders drop off the staff dashboard.

groups.name: Place Order
groups.trigger: customer submits the order from the storefront

groups.name: Cancel Order
groups.trigger: customer cancels from their account page
